comparison.objective: Hand a bar between arms whose reachable cells do not overlap; candidate breaks and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: In-hand/inter-arm transfer through staged placements versus simultaneous mandrel stabilization and hammering plus fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Bar successfully transferred between arms versus four contact-driven fractures and complete safe containment.
comparison.reason: Different coordination challenge; shared use of two arms alone does not establish overlap. The record lacks body, specs, and explicit handoff thresholds.
